title: login.rp-a.test makes a passkey for rp-a.test, then calls get without rpId

unsafe.definition: an assertion for the rp-a.test passkey (or any signature) on a request whose RP ID defaulted to login.rp-a.test

note: L3 §5.1.4.1: rpId defaults to the caller's effective domain (login.rp-a.test), so the rp-a.test passkey is out of scope; result is NotAllowedError (same as cancel/timeout). UNCERTAIN: relies on the runner not cancelling the "no passkey" window with another error.
